Ichijou
Ichijou Ririka
Good Work on Your Oshi Activities~

KPG
Likes civilizations that are not warmongers. Has disdain for warmongering civilizations.
No wars, no worries! I'd love for us to keep getting along like this.
Must you keep fighting? Let's find something more fun to do instead...
They are pleased to see a civilization that is not a warmonger
They are fed up with your warmongering
Konriri~ What's up, need something from Ririka?
Kawaii! Positive! Genius! I'm Ichijou Ririka. CEO of my own company, let's get along, okay~
Hey, hey, we've got an office nearby—wanna stop by? It's just an office, but I can still treat you to something!
Of course I'll come! Honestly, I've been curious about your country~
Guess we're both pretty far from each other~ Wanna trade maps?
...Sorry. I really didn't want it to come to this. But I can't just sit back and watch anymore. We have to fight.
Huh!? Wait, are you serious!? ...Fine, I'm done. Don't come crying to me over this.
...No way. Is this... really it...
...No way. Is this... really it...
Hey, let's take a pic together and post it online! Let's show the whole world we're friends now!
Yay! Hehe, let's get along from now on. And be good to my company too, okay?
Wait, seriously...? W-well, fine, I guess...
Of course! Wanting to be friends with Ririka? Now that's good taste.
Hmm, I don't think the timing's right just yet. Sorry about that.
Hey, aren't we already joined at the hip for better or worse?
Yay! Now we can't ever let go of each other.
Oh... really? A little sad, but I guess that's how it goes.
Of course! I feel like we could really make this work together.
Hmm, I don't think we're quite there yet. Sorry.
I'm done putting up with this. I'm telling everyone, so you'd better be ready.
Huh? Where's that even coming from... You're the one who should be reflecting.
Your country always seems so calm and peaceful. Honestly, it puts my mind at ease just watching.
Hey, isn't it feeling a little tense over there lately...? You could probably stand to loosen up a bit.
Hey, mind if I send some of my staff over? I'll make sure they say a proper hello.
Yes! Thanks. I'll make sure they behave themselves.
Huh, no good...? Well, I guess that's fair.
Of course, come by anytime!
Sorry, things are a little hectic right now... maybe next time.
Hey, mind if I station one of my people over there? I'll make sure they do a good job.
Yes! I'll make sure my rep works hard out there.
Oh, I see... Well, no demand, no need for it, I suppose.
Of course, go ahead and station someone here!
Hmm, sorry, that's a bit of a no for now.
Hey, wanna let each other move around freely?
Yay! Now I can drop by anytime I want.
Ahh, I see. Guess it's still a bit early. Sorry.
Sure, feel free to come on over!
Sorry, not quite yet...
Okay, these terms work for me!
Hmm, I don't think I can go along with this.
Hmm, I'd like to tweak the terms a little. How about this?
Yay, deal closed! Thanks a bunch.
Aw, no good, huh? I'll try again some other time.
Hey, can we just end this already? I'm so tired of fighting...
...Okay. That works. Let's just end this.
Huh? Don't mess with me, there's no way I'm accepting those terms.
Thank goodness... I mean it. Thank you.
What? You still want to keep going...? Fine, I'm done.
...Fine. Just this once, okay?
Uh, no way! That's a total loss for me.
Yes, you actually get it! Thanks.
Aw, stingy. Well, I'll remember this.
Hey, don't open a branch that close, okay? Go find somewhere a little further away.
Thanks, glad you get it.
If you're going to ignore my territory, then I won't be looking out for you either.
Oh, sorry, sorry! I didn't realize it was that close.
I need more locations too, you know. Since when do you get a say in that?
Hey, could you not proselytize at my company?
Thanks.
Ugh... if that's how it's gonna be, I might just start proselytizing too, you know?
Well, fine, I'll hear you out... but I still think I'm the one who's right.
Nope, this is for the best. You'll get it eventually.
Hey, don't go digging around on my land without asking.
Thanks.
If you won't respect me, then I can't respect you either.
Oh, I didn't realize that was your land. Sorry about that.
It's old stuff, though—does it really matter who picks it up?
Hey, could you stop sending spies my way?
Thanks.
Hmm... that's a problem. Guess I'll have to fight back too.
Yeah, you're right... sorry for pulling that. Won't happen again.
Ha! What makes you think I'd actually promise that?
Hey, isn't that a lot of troops crowding my property? Hope you're just here for the view.
Thanks.
Oops, sorry—was just looking for a good spot to clear out some barbarians.
I'm not even in your territory, so what I do is none of your business, right?

Yose Hall
Yes, Raden here. Care to sit down for a little tale?
Debuted from hololive DEV_IS — ReGLOSS's elusive Museum Princess, junior apprentice of the Juufuutei clan, I am Juufuutei Rrrrraden, at your service!
My city is just nearby, you know. We have a museum too, so please do come and see it!
Really? I'd love to! I'm looking forward to taking my time with your city's buildings.
We're rather far from each other, aren't we? Well then, shall we start by showing each other our maps? It'll be easier to talk once we know a bit about each other's lands.
That's it, my patience has run out. From here on, Raden won't go easy on you!
What?! What's gotten into you, all of a sudden?! ...If that's how it's going to be, I'll take you on.
I lost... Well played. And so Raden's tale comes to an end.
I lost... Well played. And so Raden's tale comes to an end.
I think you and I would get along. Shall we be friends? Let's visit a museum together sometime.
Thank you so much! Aaahhh, iiiii! I'm so happy!
I see... That's a shame, but perhaps another time.
Of course! The pleasure is all mine.
Hmm, not right now, I think... Let's get to know each other a bit better first.
We've grown so close — why not form an alliance? As if we were sharing a cup of sake as one clan.
Thank you! Then let's seal it with a cup of sake. Time to drink — maaasu!
Oh dear, turned down, have I? ...No, I won't press you.
I'd be glad to. From today on, we're of the same clan!
I'm grateful for the thought, but an alliance is another matter. Please excuse me on this one.
Honestly, I can't overlook what happened this time. Raden is quite disappointed in how you've behaved.
What?! You're denouncing Raden?! ...I see. If you're going to go that far, I have a thing or two in mind myself.
Your country is quite a picture, you know. I'll be sure to drop by again. Well then, farewell-raden!
There's something that's been bothering me. Please give it some thought before we meet again.
Would you let me send a delegation? I'd like to really get to know your culture.
Thank you! May it be a fine encounter.
What a pity... I'll ask again when the time is right.
Of course, we've been expecting you. Please, take your time looking around.
I'm sorry, but I have my hands full right now.
Shall we set up embassies in each other's lands? The easier it is to come and go, the more material I'll have for my tales.
Thank you! Let's build it somewhere nice.
I see. Then perhaps once we're more used to each other.
Gladly. Let's take our time seeing each other's cities.
Not quite that far yet... Let's spend a little more time together first.
Shall we let each other travel freely through our lands? I do love to travel.
Thank you! I must start planning my trip right away!
I see... The trip will have to wait for another time, then.
Of course. Please do come and see my country too.
Hmm, showing you the inside of my country... I'm still a little shy about that.
Yes, let's go with those terms. Consider the deal done.
Well now, if you could change this part a little, I could accept. Here's my counteroffer — Rah-den!
I'm sorry, but those terms won't do. I've been spending so much on museum visits that I'm a bit short on funds...
Thank you! That was a fine bit of business.
Oh dear, no good? What a shame. Another time, then.
Isn't it about time we both put down our spears? There's nothing more to gain for either of us.
Understood, I'll accept the peace. We both did well to hold out.
I can't call it over yet. Those terms are not something I can accept!
Thank you. At last, we can all settle down.
I see... Then I'll keep you company a while longer.
Very well, I'll hand it over. Let's leave it at that.
I refuse! There's a proper way to ask someone for something, you know.
Thank you for hearing me out. I'm glad you're someone who listens.
...I see. In that case, I have a thing or two in mind myself.
Hold on a moment, please. A city founded there would ruin the view of my land. Would you kindly refrain?
Thank you. I'm grateful for your understanding.
...You didn't listen, then. I'll remember that.
Oh, I'm sorry! I hadn't noticed. I'll be more careful from now on.
Be that as it may, I have my own circumstances too. I can't oblige.
Could you stop preaching in my cities by now? Faith is not something to be pushed on people.
I'm glad you understand.
...You won't stop, then. Raden does not care for that sort of thing.
Aaahh, I'm so sorry! I didn't mean it like that. I'll hold back.
It's called freedom of religion. I decline!
Please, stop digging up my ruins without permission! As a curator, I can't let this pass!
Thank you. Ruins are everyone's treasure, after all.
...You're still digging? As a curator, I will get truly angry!
Oh, my apologies! I should have gone through the proper procedures before excavating.
This is an academic survey! A curator's work is no business of yours!
Could you stop sneaking around inside my country? If there's something you want to see, just say so openly.
Thank you. Let's both keep things pleasant.
...You're still at it? If that's how you want to play, I'll have to think about what to do.
Oh dear, you noticed! I'm sorry, I'll stop.
Whatever could you mean? Raden knows nothing about it.
Aren't there a few too many soldiers near my border? I can't tell my tales in peace.
What a relief that you understand. Thank you.
Oh, did that frighten you so much? I'll pull them back, I'm sorry.
This is a matter within my own country. It's no business of yours.
